mobile.noLists: No task lists yet. Add one above.

mobile.noCalendars: No calendars yet. Add one above.
mobile.deleteCalendarMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Its events are removed too.
mobile.birthdayCalendarRemindersHint: Default reminders for this birthday calendar — for example one week before. Birthdays are all-day, so a reminder fires at the start of the day rather than the night before.
mobile.subtaskRowHint: Double tap to toggle done. More actions available.
mobile.contactHint: Double-tap to edit. Swipe up or down to delete.
mobile.syncRefreshHint: Double tap to sync and refresh external data now.
mobile.syncPathHint: A shared folder both devices can reach (e.g. a synced cloud folder).
mobile.syncSustainedFailure: Sync has failed several times in a row. Check your sync target and connection; "Sync now" retries immediately.
mobile.oauthNoCode: The sign-in did not return an authorization code. Please try again.

mobile.syncFieldsRequired: Please fill in the required fields first.
mobile.syncPreviewStale: Target changed — check the dataset again before joining.

conferencing.label: Video meeting
conferencing.openFailed: The meeting could not be opened: {{message}}
conferencing.invitationLanguageHint: Which language the join details are written into the event in. They are fixed afterwards — the event goes to every attendee like that.
conferencing.personalRoomHint: The personal room needs no scheduling licence and has no daily cap, but it is always the same room behind the same link — back-to-back events can walk into each other there.
conferencing.meetingOwned: A meeting was created for this event. Removing it deletes it at the provider too.
conferencing.saveEventFirst: Save the event, then you can create a meeting for it.
conferencing.meetingCreated: Meeting created and attached to the event.
conferencing.meetingNotOwned: This event already has a meeting that Aperio did not create. Take it over to be able to remove it as well.
conferencing.meetingAdopted: Meeting taken over. It can now be removed as well.
conferencing.meetingFailed: The meeting could not be changed: {{message}}

kind.appStart: On next app start after due

reminders.appStartHint: Fires on the next launch after the due time.

refreshErrors.announce: Warning: updating one or more accounts is failing. Details are on the Sync screen.
refreshErrors.announceAuth: Warning: updating one or more accounts is failing, likely an authentication problem. Details are on the Sync screen.
refreshErrors.banner: Some accounts are not updating. Details are on the Sync screen.
refreshErrors.bannerAuth: Some accounts are not updating — possibly a password problem. Details are on the Sync screen.
refreshErrors.heading: Update problems for {{name}}
refreshErrors.authHint: The errors look like an authentication problem — re-enter the password via "Reconnect" on the accounts screen.

syncStatus.label: Sync status
syncStatus.announceConflict_one: A new sync conflict needs your decision.
syncStatus.announceAuthFailed: Sync sign-in failed. Please check your sync credentials in the settings.
syncStatus.announceSchemaTooOld: The sync dataset was created by a newer Aperio version. Please update the app.
syncStatus.notifyConflictBody_one: A sync conflict needs your decision. Open Aperio to resolve it.
syncStatus.notifyConflictBody_other: {{count}} sync conflicts need your decision. Open Aperio to resolve them.

syncSchemaTooOld.title: Update required
syncSchemaTooOld.body: The existing sync dataset was created with a newer version of Aperio and is not compatible with this version.
syncSchemaTooOld.hint: Update the app to resume syncing. Your local data stays readable in the meantime, but no further changes are written to the sync store.

syncStaleResume.title: This device was offline for a while
syncStaleResume.body: Some changes were compacted on the sync store. The current data state will now be downloaded in full (snapshot from {{time}}).
syncStaleResume.mergeHint: Local changes you made while offline are kept in the local push queue and will be sent to the other devices on the next sync round.

syncAccountsConnect.title: Reconnect accounts
syncAccountsConnect.body: We pulled in your accounts from the sync store, but the passwords and tokens are stored only on each device. Please re-attach the credentials for the following accounts so this device can reach them too.
syncAccountsConnect.bodyRepair: The provider no longer accepts the stored credentials for the following accounts — every update attempt is rejected. Re-enter the current password (for Google or Microsoft: sign in again) so updates work again.
syncAccountsConnect.hint: You can also dismiss this dialog and reconnect later from Settings → Accounts. Until then, calendars and tasks from these accounts will be unavailable on this device.
syncAccountsConnect.hintRepair: You can also close this dialog and repair the connection later from Settings → Accounts. Until then, the affected calendars and tasks keep showing the last successfully fetched data.
syncAccountsConnect.oauthHint: Opens the sign-in page in your default browser.
syncAccountsConnect.errorAuth: The credentials were rejected. Please check and try again.
syncAccountsConnect.errorNetwork: Network error while reaching the account.
syncAccountsConnect.errorInvalidInput: The input is not valid for this account type.
syncAccountsConnect.errorEmpty: Please enter a value before saving.

firstLaunchWizard.title: Welcome to Aperio
firstLaunchWizard.languageHint: Choose the language Aperio uses. You can change this any time in Settings.
firstLaunchWizard.syncHint: Restore your data from an existing sync target, or set up a new one to sync across your devices. You can also skip this and set it up later in Settings. If you connect to a target that already holds an Aperio dataset, your data and accounts are restored and the wizard finishes.
firstLaunchWizard.accountHint: Connect a calendar or task account (CalDAV, Google, Microsoft, Vikunja, Todoist, …), or skip and add one later in Settings.

contact.photoUnsupportedType: Please pick a JPEG, PNG, or GIF image.
contact.birthdayHint: Optional — the contact's date of birth.
contact.membersHint: One member per line. Use "Name <email>" to keep a display name, or paste a bare email address.
contact.loadFailed: This contact could not be loaded.
contact.readOnlyHint: This contact is in a read-only address book and cannot be edited.

logs.hint: Aperio keeps a rolling log file to help diagnose problems. Choose how much detail to record, view the latest lines, or export the log to send for support.
logs.levelHint: Higher levels record more detail but make the log noisier. Use Debug or Trace only while reproducing a problem.
logs.redactHint: Replaces e-mail addresses and access tokens with placeholders before exporting. Leave on unless support asks otherwise.
logs.clearConfirm: Delete the stored log files? The current session keeps logging.

general.weekStartHint: Sets which weekday the week and month views start on. Calendar week numbers stay ISO 8601 (Monday-based).
general.startOnTodayHint: When on, every calendar view opens on today each time you start the app, instead of the day you last had open. Synced across your devices.
general.showCancelledHint: When on, cancelled meetings stay visible in the calendar (like Outlook). When off, they're hidden. Either way, cancelled events never trigger reminders. Synced across your devices.
general.showHiddenCalendarTargetsHint: When on, calendars you've hidden in the sidebar can still be picked as the target when creating, editing, or moving an event. When off, only currently-shown calendars are offered (an event's own calendar always stays available). Synced across your devices.
general.fontSizeHint: Scales the whole interface — text and spacing alike. Default 100%, stored on this device only.
general.themeHint: Light or dark palette for Aperio. Stored on this device only.
general.hapticsHint: A short vibration when an external-data refresh starts and finishes. Stored on this device only.
general.appBadgeHint: Show a number on the app icon for today's open tasks plus events still ahead today. Stored on this device only; needs notification permission.
general.backgroundSyncHint: Periodically sync calendars, tasks and contacts even when the app isn't open, so a peer's changes and new reminders arrive on time. The system decides the exact timing (battery and network permitting), so it is not immediate. Stored on this device only.
general.autostartLabel: Launch Aperio when I sign in
general.autostartHint: Aperio launches automatically when you sign in to this computer, so reminders keep firing without opening it by hand. Applies to this device only.
general.autostartMinimizedLabel: Start minimized in the system tray
general.autostartMinimizedHint: On autostart, Aperio starts tucked in the tray instead of opening a window — click the tray icon to bring it up. Needs a system tray (see below).
general.autostartUnavailable: Launching at login isn't available in this environment.
general.trayIntro: Keep Aperio running in the background — the reminder scheduler stays active and notifications still fire while the window is hidden in the tray.
general.trayUnavailable: This system has no usable tray, so these options stay off and the window closes/minimizes normally. (On Linux, GNOME needs an AppIndicator extension to show a tray.)
general.closeToTray: Minimize to the tray when closing
general.closeToTrayHint: The close button hides Aperio in the tray instead of quitting. Use the tray icon's menu to quit.
general.minimizeToTray: Minimize to the tray instead of the taskbar
general.minimizeToTrayHint: The minimize button hides Aperio in the tray. Click the tray icon to bring the window back.

dayViewMode.heading: Calendar day layout
dayViewMode.hint: How the calendar's day and week views lay out events. "Hour grid" places events on a 24-hour timeline, sized by duration. "Compact list" stacks them as a chronological list, each block still sized by duration. Tasks size by effort in both. Purely visual — also switchable from the calendar toolbar.

dayWindow.heading: Visible hours
dayWindow.hint: The hour grid shows only this window of the day. Events outside it appear in a small band at the top or bottom. If the start is at or after the end, the full day is shown.

calendars.hint: Default reminders that apply to events without their own reminder. Useful for iCloud calendars: iOS “Default Alert Times” aren't written into the event itself, so without a default here the alarm doesn't show in Aperio.
calendars.empty: No calendars yet — add an account first.

notifications.heading: Notification sounds
notifications.hint: The sound a reminder plays. Calendars, task lists, individual items and reminders can each override this default.

plugins.hint: Plugins extend Aperio with calendar, sync, videoconference and notification adapters. Bundled plugins ship with the app; community plugins land in plugins/user/.
plugins.author: Author

interactiveAuth.label: Sign-in
interactiveAuth.title: Runs an interactive OAuth-style sign-in flow.

discover.label: Service discovery
discover.title: Probes the user's domain for service endpoints (e.g. EWS Autodiscover).

probeHostKey.label: Host-key probe
probeHostKey.title: Reads a server's TOFU host-key fingerprint (e.g. SFTP first-use trust dialog).

toggle.activeSyncConflict: This is the sync adapter you're currently using. Switch to a different one in Settings → Sync, then come back to disable it.

install.name: Name
install.unsignedWarning: ⚠ This plugin is not signed. Only install plugins from trusted sources.
install.restartRequired: A previous version of this plugin is already loaded. Restart Aperio so the new version takes effect.

uninstall.title: Uninstall plugin
uninstall.warning: ⚠ Accounts that use this plugin will stop working until you re-install it. Their configuration stays in place — they re-activate automatically once the plugin is available again.
uninstall.restartRequired: Couldn't drop the plugin: {{error}}. Restart Aperio and try again.

remote.heading: Plugins needed
remote.hint: These plugins are installed on your other devices but not on this one. Install the matching .aperio archive via the button above to make them available here.

failed.heading: Couldn't be loaded
failed.hint: These plugin files are installed but Aperio refused to load them. Accounts that depend on them are inactive until you re-install a compatible version.

reason.abiMismatchOlderPlugin: This plugin was built for an older Aperio (ABI v{{plugin}}; this Aperio speaks ABI v{{host}}). Install a newer version of the plugin built for the current Aperio.
reason.abiMismatchNewerPlugin: This plugin was built for a newer Aperio (ABI v{{plugin}}; this Aperio speaks ABI v{{host}}). Update Aperio to use this plugin.
reason.appTooOld: This plugin requires Aperio {{required}} or newer; you're running {{running}}. Update Aperio and restart.
reason.manifestInvalid: The plugin's manifest is missing, malformed, or declares an unknown plugin type. Re-install from a fresh .aperio archive.
reason.libraryLoad: Aperio couldn't load the plugin's shared library — it may be corrupt or built for a different operating system / architecture. Re-install from a fresh .aperio archive for your platform.
reason.other: Aperio couldn't load this plugin. See the technical details below.

contacts.privacyBody: Aperio syncs your contacts directly with the connected providers and keeps names, email addresses, phone numbers, birthdays, and organisation fields in memory so search and the attendees picker stay responsive.
contacts.privacyProvidersIntro: What each provider collects and how long they retain it is governed by their own privacy policies:
contacts.providerPolicyOthers: For CardDAV, iCloud, and Exchange accounts the privacy policy of your server applies.
contacts.syncBody: All writable address books sync at app start and at the configured interval. Heavy read-only directories (GAL / Suggested People / Other Contacts / Workspace Directory) only pull on demand.
contacts.includeDirectoriesHint: When ticked, every sync — manual and periodic — also pulls the read-only directories (GAL / Suggested People / Other Contacts / Workspace Directory). May take several minutes depending on account size. The setting is remembered across restarts.
contacts.includeDirectoriesEnabled: Read-only directories will be included on the next sync.
contacts.includeDirectoriesDisabled: Read-only directories will be skipped on the next sync.
contacts.cacheBody: Drops the in-memory snapshots of every external address book. Your own local contacts and the local “Contacts” folder are not affected — the next sync re-pulls provider data.
contacts.cacheCleared_zero: Cache cleared — no connected accounts to notify.
contacts.cacheClearFailed: Couldn't fully clear the cache. See log for details.

sync.stateConfiguredSimple: Sync adapter is connected. See the connection details below.
sync.stateChosenNotRunning: A sync target is chosen, but this device is not syncing through it. See Sync target below.
sync.connectedSummaryNotRunning: Chosen sync target: {{detail}}. This device is not syncing through it.
sync.compactDone: Snapshot taken, {{deleted}} old log files deleted.
sync.targetIntro: Pick the account that holds the sync dataset. Its address and credentials live with the account under Settings, Accounts; here you only decide which one this device uses.
sync.targetStatusCurrent: This device syncs through the account {{name}}.
sync.targetStatusNone: This device syncs through no account.
sync.targetStatusBroken: This device is set to sync through the account {{name}}, but syncing through it did not start. Try it again below, or pick another account.
sync.targetSelectorLabel: Accounts that can hold the sync dataset
sync.targetOptionAvailable: does not hold the sync dataset
sync.targetOptionBroken: is meant to hold the sync dataset, but syncing through it did not start
sync.targetOtherNote: {{name}} does not hold this device's sync dataset.
sync.targetBrokenNote: {{name}} is this device's chosen sync target, but syncing through it did not start. Trying again says why.
sync.targetSelected: This device now syncs through the account {{name}}.
sync.targetEmpty: None of your accounts can hold a sync dataset. Add one for a storage location under Settings, Accounts.
sync.targetAddAccount: Add an account (goes to the account settings)
sync.targetFieldRequired: {{label}} is needed before this target can be reached.
sync.onboardPreviewExisting: There is already an Aperio dataset here. Connecting joins it, and this device adopts what it holds.
sync.onboardRestoreOk: Joined the dataset on this target.
sync.onboardCreateOk: Started a new dataset on this target.
sync.targetHostKeyUntrusted: This server's fingerprint has not been confirmed on this device yet. Check it before this account holds the dataset.
sync.targetPluginMissing: No plugin for this account is installed on this device. Without it the account cannot hold the sync dataset.
sync.targetLoadFailed: The list of accounts could not be loaded: {{message}}
sync.adapterSftpHostKeyMismatch: Warning: the server's host key changed since the last connection. This could be a harmless server reinstall — or an attack. Verify the new fingerprint with the server admin before reconnecting.
sync.sftpTrustNewBody: This is the first time Aperio is connecting to this SFTP server. Verify that the fingerprint below matches what the server administrator gave you out-of-band (e.g. via a phone call or a separate channel) before accepting.
sync.sftpTrustChangedBody: The server's host key is different from the one Aperio pinned previously. This can mean a harmless server reinstall — or a man-in-the-middle attack. Verify the new fingerprint with the server administrator before accepting; cancel and abort otherwise.
sync.sftpTrustVerifyHint: Compare the SHA256 fingerprint against the one the administrator provided. The strings must match exactly, character for character.
sync.sftpTrustCancelled: Cancelled. The pinned host key was left unchanged.
sync.sftpPinHint: Aperio will reject any connection to this server whose key doesn't match. Drop the pin when you know the server's key has rotated (e.g. after a reinstall).
sync.sftpForgetPinConfirm: Drop the pinned fingerprint for {{hostPort}}? The next connection will go through the first-use confirmation dialog again.
sync.sustainedFailureBanner: The last few sync rounds failed in a row. Aperio is now retrying less often (exponential backoff, capped at 30 minutes). "Sync now" runs a fresh attempt immediately; otherwise the next periodic round will resume the normal cadence once a round succeeds.
sync.authFailureBanner: Sync sign-in failed. The credentials for the configured sync target are missing or incorrect. Update the password / key below and click "Connect" to retry.
sync.protocolBody: Recent sync rounds, newest first. Useful for diagnosing transient failures or verifying that periodic rounds are firing as expected. Kept for the last ~200 rounds.
sync.protocolClearConfirm: Drop every entry in the sync protocol? This only affects the local diagnostic history; no sync data is touched.
sync.adapterDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect this sync target? Syncing stops on this device, and the account is removed from it along with its credentials. The dataset's end-to-end encryption key is kept.
sync.deviceNameHint: The name this device goes by in every other device's list. Without one it shows up as its bare identifier. The name belongs to this device alone and reaches the others on the next sync round.
sync.deviceNameCleared: Device name removed. This device shows up as its identifier again.
sync.devicesIntro: Every device that has ever connected to this dataset is listed here. Entries left behind by reinstalls or test devices stay put and keep old log files alive — removing them clears up both.
sync.devicesStatusNone: No device besides this one is registered.
sync.devicesNoTarget: This device syncs through no target, so there is no device list.
sync.devicesLoadFailed: The device list could not be read: {{message}}
sync.deviceLastSeenUnknown: Last seen: unknown — this device has not reported in from a version that records it.
sync.deviceStaleNote: This device has fallen behind the dataset and has to load the snapshot when it next starts.
sync.deviceForgetConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the device list? No data is deleted — only the entry that counts this device as a participant. If the device is still running, it registers again on its next round.
sync.connectEmptyReveal: Empty target — you're setting up a new dataset here. Optionally enable encryption, then click "Connect" again.
sync.errorNotFound: No dataset found at the path.
sync.errorSchemaTooOld: Sync dataset needs a newer Aperio version.
sync.errorEncryption: Encrypted dataset, but no password configured.
sync.targetKeyPassphraseLabel: Passphrase for the dataset on this target
sync.errorKeyMismatch: This device still holds an encryption key from an earlier setup — the system keychain keeps it even when Aperio's data folder is deleted — and it does not open this dataset. Nothing was changed.
sync.credentialsSyncedNote: Account credentials (passwords and tokens) sync end-to-end encrypted, so your accounts work on every device without re-entering them.
sync.credentialsLocalNote: Account credentials stay on this device only (in the system keychain). Turn on end-to-end encryption to sync them securely to your other devices.
sync.e2eEnableHint: All log files and snapshots are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they leave this device. The storage only sees encrypted blobs.
sync.e2eIrreversibleWarning: Warning: without this passphrase the data cannot be recovered. Store it somewhere safe.
sync.e2eRemoteRequiresPassphrase: This dataset is encrypted. Enter the passphrase to unlock this device's view of the data.
sync.passphraseChangeHint: Set a new passphrase for end-to-end encryption. The encrypted data itself stays unchanged — other devices that are already connected keep syncing. The new passphrase is only needed when connecting an additional device from now on.
sync.passphraseChangeErrorEmpty: Please fill in both passphrase fields.
sync.passphraseChangeErrorSame: The new passphrase must differ from the current one.
sync.passphraseChangeErrorAuth: The current passphrase is not correct.
sync.disableE2eHint: Disabling encryption rewrites every log and snapshot on the sync store as plaintext. Synced account credentials are removed from the sync store and kept only in this device's keychain. Other connected devices will need to be re-onboarded after this completes — their stored key won't match the new plaintext format.
sync.disableE2eConfirm: Disable end-to-end encryption on this dataset? Every log and snapshot is rewritten as plaintext, and your synced account credentials are removed from the sync store (they stay in this device's keychain). Other connected devices will need to be re-onboarded — their stored key no longer matches. This cannot be undone without re-enabling encryption from scratch.
sync.disableE2eErrorNeedsPassphrase: Please enter the current passphrase above first.
sync.disableE2eOkAnnouncement: Encryption disabled. {{logs}} log files rewritten as plaintext.
sync.enableE2eHint: Encrypts every log and snapshot already on the sync store, then any future round, with AES-256-GCM. The storage will only see ciphertext from this point on. Your account credentials are uploaded encrypted too, so your accounts keep working on your other devices without re-entry. The passphrase you set here is the only way to recover the dataset — there is no backup or reset.
sync.enableE2eMultiDeviceWarning: If other devices are already syncing this dataset, they will need to enter the new passphrase once before they can continue syncing. Devices that already finished syncing before you click here keep working — they only stall on the next round.
sync.enableE2eConfirm: Enable end-to-end encryption on this dataset? Every log and snapshot on the sync store is re-uploaded as ciphertext, and your account credentials are uploaded encrypted so your accounts work on your other devices. Other connected devices will need to enter the new passphrase once before they can continue syncing. This passphrase is the only way to recover the dataset — make sure you can recall it.
sync.enableE2eErrorConflict: Another device just turned encryption on for this dataset. Enter the passphrase that device chose to continue syncing.
sync.enableE2eOkAnnouncement: Encryption enabled. {{logs}} log files re-uploaded as ciphertext.
sync.adoptRemoteE2eTitle: Encryption was enabled on another device
sync.adoptRemoteE2eHint: Another device on this dataset has turned on end-to-end encryption. Enter the passphrase that device chose to continue syncing here.

syncConflicts.title: Sync conflicts
syncConflicts.intro_one: One field was edited differently on two devices. Pick which version to keep.
syncConflicts.intro_other: {{count}} fields were edited differently on two devices. Pick which version to keep for each.
syncConflicts.loadError: Couldn't load conflicts. Close and reopen to try again.
syncConflicts.actionSaveBothUnsupported: "Save both" isn't available yet in this version.

checkoffMode.heading: Check-off behaviour
checkoffMode.hint: What the check-off gesture (Space or clicking the circle) does. The default flips between open and completed. The status cycle instead steps open → in progress → completed → open, so the "in progress" step is reachable directly.

statusCoupling.heading: Status coupling
statusCoupling.label: Couple parent and subtask status
statusCoupling.hint: When enabled, completing a parent task marks its open subtasks complete, and finishing every subtask marks the parent complete. Disable to treat each task independently — status changes never propagate up or down the tree.

autoDate.heading: Auto-date on start
autoDate.label: Pin a backlog task to today when work begins
autoDate.hint: When enabled, a task without a scheduled day gets today's date the moment its status flips to in progress — directly or via the cascade from a child. Disable to leave the scheduled day alone.

autoSelfAssign.heading: Self-assignment
autoSelfAssign.label: Assign shared-list tasks to me
autoSelfAssign.hint: When enabled, an unassigned task in a shared list (e.g. Vikunja) is assigned to me automatically the moment I set it in progress or done; setting it back to open removes only my assignment. For recurring tasks only the completed instance is assigned — the next instance stays unassigned. Disable to keep assignments manual.

visualEffortSizing.heading: Effort as tile size
visualEffortSizing.label: Show tasks larger/smaller by effort
visualEffortSizing.hint: When enabled, task tiles render at different sizes depending on the task's effort (small/medium/large), so you can see at a glance how full a day is. Purely visual — the effort is always announced in the task's label regardless. Disable to render every tile the same size.

showHiddenTaskListTargets.heading: Hidden lists as targets
showHiddenTaskListTargets.label: Offer hidden lists as targets
showHiddenTaskListTargets.hint: When on, task lists you've hidden in the sidebar can still be picked as the target when creating, editing, or moving a task. When off, only currently-shown lists are offered (a task's own list always stays available). Synced across your devices.

carryOverDefault.heading: Carry-over default
carryOverDefault.hint: On startup, decide what happens to tasks whose scheduled day has passed and that are still open. "Ask" opens the carry-over dialog; the other options run silently and announce the result.

dayStartTrigger.heading: Day-start trigger
dayStartTrigger.hint: When to run the carry-over, missed-deadline, and deadline-pin checks on a long-running app. "At midnight" fires as soon as the local date rolls over. Pick a morning hour to defer the dialog until you're at the desk. "App start only" disables the day-change re-check entirely (legacy behaviour).
dayStartTrigger.label: Trigger

reminders.heading: Day-start reminders
reminders.hint: What the day-start review reminds you about. Each reminder can be turned off independently.

untimedToday.label: Remind me of today's untimed tasks
untimedToday.hint: When enabled, the day-start review lists tasks scheduled for today that have no specific time — the ones easy to forget. Disable to skip the untimed-tasks reminder.

deadlineArrived.label: Remind me when a deadline has arrived
deadlineArrived.hint: When enabled, you're reminded on the day a task's deadline falls due. Disable to skip the deadline-day reminder.

deadlineCountdown.label: Remind me before a deadline
deadlineCountdown.hint: When enabled, you're reminded a set number of days ahead of a task's deadline, so it doesn't sneak up on you. Set the lead time below.

countdownDays.label: Days before the deadline
countdownDays.hint: How many days ahead of a deadline the early reminder fires. Between 1 and 30 days.

perList.heading: Per task list
perList.hint: Override the three defaults above for individual task lists. Leave a field on "Global default" to inherit; pick a specific value to make this list behave differently from the rest.
perList.empty: No task lists yet — add an account or create a local list first.

confirm.deleteTaskListMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its tasks? This cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteTaskListMessageExternal: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its tasks from {{account}}? The list is removed at the source for every device, and this cannot be undone.
confirm.deleteContactListMessage: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its contacts? This cannot be undone.

plan.title: Schedule "{{title}}"
plan.hint: Pick a date for this task, or move it back to the backlog.

dayStartReview.title: Day-start review
dayStartReview.hint: Tasks that need a decision now that yesterday is over. Resolve them one by one or use the bulk actions per section.
dayStartReview.hintRemindersOnly: Reminders for today — nothing needs a decision here. Close with OK when you are done reading.

deadlinePin.announce_one: 1 task reached its deadline today and was pinned to today.
deadlinePin.announce_other: {{count}} tasks reached their deadline today and were pinned to today.

deleteScope.title: Delete recurring event
deleteScope.message: "{{title}}" is part of a series. Delete just this occurrence, or the whole series?
deleteScope.notifyRevealed: You organize this meeting — choose above whether to notify attendees.
deleteScope.organizerMessage: "{{title}}" is part of a series you organize. Choose below whether attendees are notified, then the scope:

moveScope.title: Move recurring event
moveScope.message: "{{title}}" is part of a series. Move just this occurrence, or the whole series?

editScope.title: Edit recurring event
editScope.message: "{{title}}" is part of a series. Edit just this occurrence, this and all following, or the whole series?

taskDeleteScope.title: Delete recurring reminder
taskDeleteScope.message: "{{title}}" repeats. Delete only this occurrence, or this and all following? Completed reminders are kept either way.
taskDeleteScope.deleted: "{{title}}" was deleted from this occurrence on.

colorPicker.title: Custom color
colorPicker.intro: Enter a color as a hex value (#rrggbb) or pick it with the swatch.
colorPicker.saveToPalette: Save as a named label in the palette
colorPicker.kindUnavailable: No plugin is loaded for this kind.

colorLabels.title: Color labels
colorLabels.emptyHint: No color labels yet — add your first below.

event.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
event.occurrenceCancelled: This occurrence of "{{title}}" was cancelled; attendees notified.
event.thisAndFutureDeleted: "{{title}}" was deleted from this occurrence on; earlier ones stay.
event.thisAndFutureCancelled: "{{title}}" was cancelled from this occurrence on; attendees notified, earlier ones stay.
event.thisAndFutureUpdated: "{{title}}" was changed from this occurrence on; earlier ones are unchanged.

privacyNotice.title: Privacy notice
privacyNotice.body: Aperio syncs your contacts directly with the connected provider and keeps the data in memory so the attendees picker and search stay responsive. Names, email addresses, phone numbers, birthdays, and organisation fields are kept; photos are loaded lazily on demand.
privacyNotice.providerLine: What {{provider}} collects and how long it's retained is governed by their privacy policy:
privacyNotice.providerGeneric: For CalDAV / CardDAV / iCloud / Exchange servers your provider's privacy policy applies — your administrator can point you at it if you need the exact link.
privacyNotice.cacheHint: You can clear the local cache at any time under Settings → Contacts → "Clear cache".

accounts.googleClientIdHint: From your Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID, type "Desktop App"). Aperio needs your own client ID until it ships its own verified Google app registration.
accounts.googleClientSecretHint: Sits right under the client ID in the same Cloud Console entry. Despite the name, Google's own docs concede the secret isn't actually secret for Desktop apps — Aperio stores it next to the client ID in the local DB.
accounts.googleFlowHint: Pressing "Add" opens your browser to Google's consent screen. The tab closes itself once you grant access.
accounts.oauthOwnIntegrationHint: This build carries no credentials of its own for this provider. Register your own integration with it and enter that integration's client ID and secret here.
accounts.oauthFlowHint: Adding the account opens your browser at the provider's sign-in. The tab closes itself once you grant access.
accounts.microsoftClientIdHint: From the Azure portal (Entra ID → App registrations → your app → Application (client) ID). Register the app as type "Public client/native (mobile & desktop)" with redirect URI "http://localhost".
accounts.microsoftAuthorityConsumers: Personal Microsoft accounts only (outlook.com, hotmail.com, live.com)
accounts.microsoftFlowHint: Pressing "Add" opens your browser to Microsoft's sign-in page. Unlike Google, no client secret is required — PKCE alone is enough.
accounts.deviceGrantBody: Aperio will ask for permission to your device's calendars and reminders. They stay on this device only — this account is never synced to your other devices.
